text: One dashboard window: create a file comment and wait for autosave.
Edit the autosaved comment. The next save must keep the same draft ID.
Edit the autosaved comment. The next save must keep the same draft ID. Ctrl+End moves to the end.
Open Reply and autosave an overall review comment.
Update the overall comment, then reopen Reply to confirm it was saved.
Update the overall comment, then reopen Reply to confirm it was saved. Ctrl+End moves to the end.
Clear the summary. Ctrl+A and Backspace delete its saved overall draft.
Clear the summary. Ctrl+A and Backspace delete its saved overall draft. Ctrl+A selects the current text.
Write a replacement overall comment. A new saved draft is created.
Choose Keep drafts private. End and Enter select the last option.
The comments are still private. Reopen Reply, then publish all drafts.
Choose Publish all drafts. Home and Enter select the first option.
The source comment and overall review are published once. No private copies remain.
